title: Customer fiscal setup
intro: Each customer is the issuer. Configure the current company and store; registration does not authorize issuance.
draft: Draft registration: official homologation not evidenced.
private: Certificates, passwords, CSC and keys belong in private service configuration. This screen never receives or exports secrets.
dated: Dated Portuguese reference; confirm current requirements with your accountant and authority. Does not determine tax rates.
installed: Installation capabilities, not authorization of this profile
saved: Revision persisted by the API. This does not mean homologation or authorized issuance.
uncertain: Uncertain outcome. Keep this identifier and check the result; no automatic resend.
session: Session or context changed. Sign in again and look up the profile; no resend.
denied: Permission or fiscal contract unavailable. Only an active owner may configure.
conflict: Revision conflict. Look up the profile before editing again.
request: API rejected the request. Review the data and service configuration.
network: Could not confirm the service response.
readonly: Read access; only the owner may edit.
blockers: Technical blockers reported by the API
tax_rules_not_validated: Profile tax rules not yet validated
issuer_credentials_not_configured: Issuer credentials not verified for this profile
xml_schema_and_signature_not_validated: XML and signature not validated for this profile
official_transport_not_configured: Official transport not verified for this profile
uf_developer_requirements_not_validated: State developer requirements not yet verified
onboardingIntro: Save the profile and check the installed configuration. This local check sends no documents and does not prove homologation.
onboarding_configuration_required: Ask the administrator to install or correct the secure fiscal configuration.
onboarding_official_verification_require: Official homologation verification is still required.
onboarding_production_blocked: Production issuance remains blocked in this flow.
onboardingNoRemoteVerification: Local check. It does not query Focus or confirm certificate validity or tax authority authorization.
providerCredentialsIntro: Only the owner can configure this. Installation administrator opt-in is required. The issuer A1 certificate and CSC must be configured in Focus; this screen does not upload certificates.
providerReplaceWarning: Saving replaces prior credentials; an empty CSC removes the local CSC. Values will not be displayed again.
nfeScope: Internal in-person sale to a non-taxpayer final consumer, without freight charges. Recorded cash or an explicitly confirmed deferred method; items and taxes come from the original sale.
nfeUnavailable: Production, A3 and number invalidation are unavailable in this flow.
nfePrivacy: Recipient data stays in this screen session only. It is not saved in browser storage or sent to the ERP vendor.
nfeCancelOnly: This does not cancel the sale, refund payment or change stock or cash.
nfeConfirm: I confirm fiscal cancellation of this invoice
nfeFailure: Operation incomplete. Consult the same reference before retrying.
nfeError_input_missing: Check required fields: sale, method, confirmation, recipient, address, nature and purpose. Freight charges are not supported by this flow.
nfeError_tax_mapping_unsupported: Unmapped tax group or missing tax quote. Correct fiscal configuration; no tax was invented.
nfeError_provider_unavailable: Configure this company’s Focus provider with NF-e 55 profile and private token.
nfeError_network: Uncertain response. Consult the same sale; do not resend issuance.
nfeError_session: Session or context changed. Sign in again.
nfeError_focus_request_unsupported: Unmapped tax group or missing tax quote. Correct fiscal configuration; no tax was invented.
profileListHint: Profiles for this company and store. A saved registration does not prove official authorization.
nfeFrozenFreight: Freight and taxes come from the persisted quote; this form adds no charges. Taxed freight is not yet supported in this flow.
taxAccountantUnapproved: HOMOLOGATION: classification is not yet evidenced as accountant-approved. Approval will be required to enable production; production remains blocked.
cceLimits: Cannot change tax, issuer/recipient identity or dates. One attempt per invoice in this flow; uncertain results require Focus reconciliation, never automatic resend.
cceConfirm: I confirm this is permitted and does not change tax, parties or dates.
correction_authorized_homologation: CC-e recorded in homologation; sale, stock and cash are unchanged.
correction_failed: CC-e rejected; review the reason and Focus.
correction_reconciliation_required: CC-e requires reconciliation. Do not submit another attempt.
nfseMunicipalBlocked: NFS-e is unavailable in this emitter: the municipal contract, service registration and tax classification require specific review. It is not a goods invoice.
exportScope: HOMOLOGATION. UTC local-record period, not fiscal competence. Up to 500 records and 50 MiB XML; missing/uncertain records appear in CSV. Not SPED/EFD/PVA or complete Focus coverage.
exportPrivacy: ZIP contains personal data. Choose your folder; without a picker, browser settings apply. Nothing is automatically sent to an accountant.
exportSaved: File delivered to the destination or download manager. Check READ_ME.txt and missing records in CSV.
exportFailed: Export cancelled or unavailable. Check session, permission, destination and limits.
nfeArchivePending: XML is not yet archived locally. Check the private backup key and query the same invoice; do not issue another sale or invoice.
nfePaymentWarning: The deferred method is recorded on the server. It records no receipt and changes neither cash nor installments. Confirm the method agreed with the customer.
nfePaymentConfirm: I confirm this method for the entered sale.
nfeError_fiscal_conflict: Revision conflict or concurrent operation. Consult the sale and its recorded method before retrying. The existing choice was not overwritten.
